name: Chiron Helmet Foundation
description:
Item Type: Light Armor
Damage Reduction: 20%
Temp. Rating: -61 / 91 °C
Radiation Protection: 26000 REM
Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s
 
Utilizing a crystal clear protective glass treated with a specialist hydrophobic glaze, the Chiron light helmet was purpose built to protect against fogging and glare, guaranteeing that first responders will retain complete vision in emergency situations.
 
Celebrate the UEE's commitment to building a brighter future with this Foundation Festival special edition. Designed with Guides and other community leaders in mind, it features a teal polyfiber underlayer and matching accents on the carbon plating sections.
